validation.need_device: Add at least one device / variant.
validation.sku_format: The SKU/Barcode for {label} must be NST- followed by 9 digits (NST-123456789).
validation.sku_duplicate: The SKU for {label} is a duplicate. Device {other} already uses the same SKU.
validation.imei1_duplicate: IMEI 1 of {label} is a duplicate. The same IMEI cannot be used on more than one device.
validation.imei2_duplicate: IMEI 2 of {label} is a duplicate. The same IMEI cannot be used on more than one device.

used_copy_help: Everything written on the new product (description, specifications, key features, FAQ, box) is copied here in one click. IMEI, price and condition are not copied.

help.booking_min: Minimum 10% when set as a percentage.
help.ram_default: Keep Default for Apple/iPhone; the RAM option stays hidden for customers.
help.sku: Required format: NST-123456789. This SKU is saved as the barcode.
help.battery_locked: Battery health is always 100% for Inactive / Not Activated / Boxed devices.
help.images_per_variant: Up to 5 images are saved per variant/device. Gallery images can also be linked from the Variant Operations page.
help.model_number: Optional. The model number of this variant/device.
help.images_watermark: Add 1–5 images per device/variant. Downloads carry the company logo/text watermark.
help.video_shared: One video is shared by every variant/device.
help.table_paste: Tables pasted from elsewhere stay as tables.
help.auto_generated: Generated automatically; you can edit it.
help.slug: The URL slug is generated automatically; you can edit it.
help.final_save: If everything looks right, press Save Product.
help.show_branch: Hide = the website only says the product is available, without branch name or piece count.

messages.step_saved: Step {step} saved safely. Draft can be resumed.
messages.draft_saved: Product draft saved to database and this browser.

used_edit_banner: Used Purchase source, original seller, purchase price transaction and IMEI history remain audit-controlled. Sellable details, variant data, images and website publication can be updated here.
price_rule_note: Customer price stays hidden until Color, Variant, Storage and SIM Network are selected.

sidebar.images_help: Add images inside each Variant / Device card. This sidebar is preview-only so the same image is not entered twice.

tips.sku: Every physical device needs a unique NST-9 digit SKU

variants.title: Variants & Physical Units
variants.help: One Variant can contain multiple physical units. Every unit keeps its own SKU/Barcode, IMEI, Purchase Price and Sale Price.
variants.shares_note: This unit shares Variant {variant}: {config}. Change the configuration on Unit 1 only.

images.shared_help: All units of this same variant share these images · JPG, PNG, WEBP · max 5
images.unit_uses_shared: This physical unit uses the shared images from Variant {variant} Unit 1.

content.manual_help: These rows are saved with the product and reflected on the customer product page. Advanced grouped import is available after the product has an ID.
content.save_first: Save the product once, then Edit it to import GSMArena / Excel / Word / CSV / HTML tables into grouped specifications.

specs.quick_help: Use one row per specification. Example: Display → 6.7 inch Super Retina XDR.
